title: The Ten Commandments
introduction: The Ten Commandments were given by God to Moses on Mount Sinai and form the basis of God's moral law. The first four concern our relationship with God, while the last six concern our relationship with others. Jesus summarized them in the commandment of love.

sections.title: No Other Gods
sections.description: The first and foundational commandment - the Lord alone is God.

sections.title: No Idolatry
sections.description: Prohibition against making images and worshipping created things.

sections.title: God's Name
sections.description: God's name must be kept holy and not misused.

sections.title: The Sabbath
sections.description: The day of rest shall be kept holy as a reminder of creation.

sections.title: Honor Your Parents
sections.description: The first commandment with a promise - to honor father and mother.

sections.title: You Shall Not Murder
sections.description: Human life is sacred because we are created in God's image.

sections.title: You Shall Not Commit Adultery
sections.description: Marriage is holy and should be protected.

sections.title: You shall not steal
sections.description: Respect for others' property and an honest way of life.

sections.title: You shall not lie
sections.description: Truthfulness and honesty in word and deed.

sections.title: You shall not covet
sections.description: Purity of heart - do not desire what belongs to others.
